title: Google SRE Book: Service Level Objectives
excerpt: Defines SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, percentiles, user-centered measurement, and error budgets for reliability decisions.

title: Google SRE Book: Monitoring Distributed Systems
excerpt: Defines black-box and white-box monitoring and frames latency, traffic, errors, and saturation as core service signals.

title: Google SRE Workbook: Alerting on SLOs
excerpt: Develops multi-window, multi-burn-rate alerting from error-budget consumption and discusses precision, recall, detection time, and reset time.

title: Google SRE Book: Managing Incidents
excerpt: Explains incident command, defined roles, operational control, communication, mitigation, and structured recovery.

title: Google SRE Book: Postmortem Culture
excerpt: Defines blameless postmortems, timelines, root and contributing causes, action items, ownership, and organizational learning.

title: OpenTelemetry Documentation: Signals
excerpt: Defines traces, metrics, logs, baggage, and profiles as complementary telemetry signals.

title: OpenTelemetry Documentation: Traces
excerpt: Defines traces, spans, parent-child relationships, context, attributes, events, status, and exporters.

title: W3C Trace Context
excerpt: Standardizes traceparent and tracestate fields for propagating distributed trace context across service boundaries.

title: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions
excerpt: Defines common attribute names and telemetry conventions that make instrumentation comparable across services and runtimes.

title: Prometheus Documentation: Alerting Rules
excerpt: Documents rule expressions, pending duration, keep-firing behavior, labels, annotations, and alert-state evaluation.

title: Prometheus Documentation: Histograms and Summaries
excerpt: Explains buckets, quantiles, aggregation, observation cost, and the differences between histograms and summaries.

title: OpenMetrics Specification
excerpt: Defines a vendor-neutral text exposition format and data model for transmitting cloud-native metrics.

title: The USE Method
excerpt: Defines systematic resource analysis through utilization, saturation, and errors for each hardware or software resource.

title: Timeouts, Retries, and Backoff with Jitter
excerpt: Explains bounded timeouts, retry amplification, exponential backoff, jitter, idempotency, and recovery behavior.

title: Avoiding Overload in Distributed Systems
excerpt: Describes admission control, load shedding, queue bounds, and feedback mechanisms that prevent overload cascades.

title: Linux perf Documentation
excerpt: Documents performance-monitoring facilities, access controls, and the security implications of profiling system and process activity.

title: DORA: A History of the Four Keys
excerpt: Defines deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and failed deployment recovery time as delivery performance measures.
